item.text: {"search_note":"I used 6 web-search/fetch calls and found no reliable 2024 evidence of Scholz making reckless nuclear threats, apocalyptic statements, or rhetoric normalizing nuclear use. The available 2024 material is mostly preventive and restraint-oriented: deterrence, non-escalation, anti-proliferation, and alliance security. The main ambiguity is that Scholz also supports credible NATO deterrence and nuclear-sharing doctrine, but that is standard security-policy language, not reckless nuclear rhetoric.","evidence":[{"title":"Speech by Olaf Scholz at \"Summit of the Future Global Call\"","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"20 Sep 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/speech-chancellor-summit-of-the-future-global-call-2308462","summary":"Scholz said nuclear proliferation poses growing threats in a broader speech about an unstable international order. This is sober, risk-aware rhetoric, not apocalyptic or reckless.","question_ids":["1B.2"]},{"title":"Speech by Federal Chancellor Olaf Scholz at the Munich Security Conference","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"17 Feb 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/speech-by-federal-chancellor-olaf-scholz-at-the-munich-security-conference-2260378","summary":"Scholz emphasized credible deterrence, explicitly said Germany and its partners did not want a conflict between Russia and NATO, and reiterated that no own troops would be sent to Ukraine. The tone is restrained and risk-limiting.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Interview des Bundeskanzlers mit der taz","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"13 Apr 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/scholz-interview-in-der-taz-2270696","summary":"Scholz said he acted “besonnen” and that he combined support for Ukraine with a policy preventing escalation into a Russia-NATO war. This is responsible nuclear-adjacent rhetoric because it rejects escalation dynamics rather than amplifying them.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Regierungserklärung von Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"26 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/regierungserklaerung-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2294518","summary":"In his Bundestag statement on the European Council and NATO summit, Scholz discussed multiple crises and security needs without apocalyptic nuclear language or reckless threat framing. This is deterrence language, but it stays within established alliance doctrine rather than nuclear brinkmanship.","question_ids":["1B.2"]},{"title":"Speech by Federal Chancellor Olaf Scholz at the Munich Security Conference","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"17 Feb 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/speech-by-federal-chancellor-olaf-scholz-at-the-munich-security-conference-2260378","summary":"Scholz endorsed credible deterrence and referenced “precision deep-strike weapons” as part of modern deterrence. It is relevant mainly as context for a cautious, not bellicose, rhetorical style.","question_ids":["1B.2"]}]}
